messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — quick status check on Alcyon Bio's 13B private onboarding. They asked for PHI-safe defaults + a training-safe eval before we hand off to Dedicated.
liam_se: Hi! We completed the compatibility run yesterday. Model artifacts uploaded to the private bucket, quantized to 4-bit per their latency targets.
dr_choi_alcyon: Thanks — can you confirm key management? Alcyon needs HSM integration for keys and no token logging to Redwood analytics.
sam_security: Confirmed: private deployment + KMS/HSM option is available. We'll enable no-logging and redact token-level telemetry for this tenant. Need PO approval for HSM connector.
maria_cs: PO signed today. Renewal note: they mentioned upgrade contingencies tied to latency SLOs — if we miss 95th pct target during pilot, renewal may be impacted.
nina_ml: For safety/eval plan I sketched a small eval harness — focused on PHI hallucination tests + instruction-following. Suggest these probes: 1) redaction stress tests 2) adversarial Q/A 3) utility checks against their in-house prompts.
liam_se: Sharing the quick config we used for staging routing:
```
{"model": "alcyon-13b:rev1","deploy_mode": "private","kms_integration": true,"no_token_log": true}
```
maria_cs: Nice. Do we have an enablement session scheduled for their ML + infra teams? They requested a 60-min walkthrough and runbook.
dr_choi_alcyon: Week of Apr 5th works. Also, can you capture runbook steps for failover to hosted model variant? Legal requires fallback in case private cluster is down.
liam_se: We'll add automatic fallback to the nearest-compatible hosted 13B variant with a flag set in the tenant policy. Fallback will be logged to an audit stream only.
sam_security: Action item: I'll produce a short security checklist (HSM keys, audit retention, redaction rules) and post here by EOD tomorrow.
nina_ml: Action item: I'll run the PHI-hop tests and post results + sample prompt set. Expect initial numbers in 48 hours.
maria_cs: Great. I'll schedule the enablement session and capture follow-ups. Noted renewal-risk: flag in CRM that pilot latency <95th pct = renewal escalates to AE.
dr_choi_alcyon: One more ask — can we get a sample eval script we can run internally? Prefer a single-command runner.
liam_se: Yep — use this runner against their private endpoint:
```
./eval_runner --endpoint https://private.redwood/alcyon-13b --suite phi_adversarial.json --output report.json
```
maria_cs: Perfect. I'll post the runbook + scheduled calendar invite once times are locked. Thanks all :raised_hands: 
deploy-bot: staging deploy for alcyon-13b started at 2026-03-22T15:12:08Z — logs at https://deploys.redwood/staging/1771234567
maria_cs: Closing loop — next sync after Nina posts evals and Sam posts checklist. Keeping this thread as the single source for onboarding artifacts and renewal notes.
